doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Submission of Motor Traffic (Drugs) Regulations, No.01 of 2025 to Parliament for approval
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - It has been stated under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act that where a police office suspects that any driver on a highway is under the influence of any intoxicating substance, it shall be lawful for such person to be produced before a Government Medical Officer for examination. Nevertheless, Regulations including provisions specifying the procedure and method to be followed in conducting tests for such determination and the threshold level of drug concentration at which a person deemed to have used drugs have not been included. Therefore, the Motor Traffic (Drugs) Regulations No.01 of 2025 have been published under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203) through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2452/40 dated 2025-09-04, incorporating provisions to enable to examine the drivers who operate their vehicles under the influence of intoxicating drugs. The proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
